proof_summary: Take the counterexample \(n=33085221781504=2^{14}\cdot4409\cdot458009\), where the two odd factors are prime. Multiplicativity over these coprime factors gives \(\sum_{d\mid n}d=66183576284700\) and \(\sum_{d\mid n}\sigma_1(d)=132367152569399\), so the sum of deficiencies is \(2(66183576284700)-132367152569399=1\), although \(n\ne1,12\).
